description: Substrate-derived ρ_K^pred via the Frobenius co-Casimir Option B (Δ_λ := 1/dim_q(λ), forced by thm:frobenius-codim-universal — zero free parameters, τ-invariant). Loads y_λ from EITHER the symbolic Wenzl-bridge witness (n=2..12, sp.Expr in q) OR the numeric Wenzl witness (n=2..30, mp.mpf at q_0) — picks whichever covers the requested n. Per repo-owner directive 2026-05-19 'all nucleotides', DEFAULT_ATOMS extended to A ≤ 10 (5Li, 6Li, 7Li, 7Be, 8Be, 9Be, 10B); gate via --max-A (default 4). Generalises rho_k_h3a_co_casimir.py from D-only. Witness MeV scaling: rows use m_e (CAL-1) as the natural scale for ρ_K^LO and the co-Casimir correction; per-atom 'M_pred_MeV' = ρ_K_pred · m_e · |tr_M|. Note: binding-via-interface-knot.witness.json uses E_0 = Q_β(n) instead — different scale by ~m_e/E_0 ≈ 0.65×.
